show_help.description: If true, lswm displays a summary of options and exits. Corresponds to the -h flag.

list_all_bt.description: If true, lswm lists all Bluetooth devices, not just Wiimotes. Corresponds to the -a flag.

long_format.description: If true, lswm outputs device details in long format. Corresponds to the -l flag.

quiet_mode.description: If true, lswm runs in quiet mode, suppressing standard output. Corresponds to the -q flag.
